newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Bank launches HK$2.0 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank launches HK$2.0 bln FRCD.

text.p: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, has launched a HK$2.0 billion floating rate certificate of deposit issue due in 2002, arranger HSBC Markets said.
The certificates were priced at par to pay a coupon of 30 basis points over the one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. There are no puts or calls.
With fees, the all-in return is 38 basis points to top-tier participants.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the certificates for use at its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
The issue also is expected to be eligible for a Hong Kong profit tax concession.
Details of the issue are as follows:
